events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Maclay Gardens
events.description: 2 deaths. Leon County. A severe downburst resulted in a large tree and power lines falling on a moving vehicle near the corner of Barclay Ln and Godfrey Place. Unfortunately, the two people in the vehicle were killed.

events.title: Lightning near Big Carlos Pass Comps Site
events.description: 1 death. Lee County. A man was fatally struck by lightning while swimming with his family at Fort Myers Beach, where he was pronounced deceased at the scene after life-saving procedures conducted by bystanders were unsuccessful. Three family members of the victim were injured by the lightning strike, and were transported to a nearby hospital in stable condition before being treated and released.

events.title: Lightning near Brighton
events.description: 2 deaths. Highlands County. Highlands County Sheriff and Florida Fish and Wildlife Conservation Commission officers discovered the vehicle and bodies of two men and their hunting dogs on a levee along a canal near Rucks Dairy Road southeast of Brighton in Highlands County. The men had reportedly gone hunting but had not returned, and were discovered two days later. Investigators suspected the fatal lightning strike likely occurred on Monday, September 22, as the men attempted to return to their car for shelter, with the time of the incident estimated from radar and satellite data.

events.title: Lightning near Coronado Beach
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. Multiple news outlets report that a 29 year old man from Colorado was struck by lightning while standing in ankle deep water on the beach near South Atlantic Ave and 27th Ave in New Smyrna Beach. The man was transported to the hospital in critical condition, but later died.

events.title: Lightning near Stonemill Creek
events.description: 1 death. Gulf County. A 43 year old male was killed by a lightning strike in a boat while fishing.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Merritt Is
events.description: 2 deaths. Brevard County. Emergency manager reported that a crane collapsed at the new Cape Canaveral hospital construction site at Borman Drive and SR-520, leading to two fatalities. Outflow winds from a thunderstorm of up to 39 to 48 knots were observed near the site around the time.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Ocala Arpt
events.description: 1 death. Marion County. Marion County Emergency Management reported one fatality resulting from a snapped tree at Matheny Fire & Emergency on SW 46th Ave. in Ocala. A lawncare working was working outside when the tree fell onto him. The event time was based on radar.

events.title: Tornado near Ft Pierce Nelson Arp
events.description: 6 deaths. St. Lucie County. A National Weather Service survey team confirmed an unusually strong, long-tracked tornado in association with Hurricane Milton produced widespread EF-1 to EF-2 damage, and periodic EF-3 damage within St. Lucie and Indian River counties. The survey determined that the tornado touched down to the south of Midway Rd. in Fort Pierce and continued on a nearly continuous path for approximately 21 miles until it moved offshore into the Atlantic Ocean near Jaycee Park in Indian River County. ||Significant vegetative and structural damage was observed along nearly the entire path length, indicating…

events.title: Lightning near Hollywood N Perry Ar
events.description: 1 death. Broward County. Broadcast media reported that a 16-year-old boy was killed by lightning after being struck while riding a bicycle in the 600 block of SW 67th Avenue in Pembroke Pines during a thunderstorm. The boy was taken to a nearby hospital where he was later pronounced dead. Time is approximate and is based on the timing of a severe thunderstorm that was affecting the area at the time, as well as from National Lightning Detection Network data showing several cloud-to-ground strikes in close proximity.

events.title: Lightning near Naples
events.description: 1 death. Collier County. Local broadcast media reported two males sustaining injuries from a lightning strike in the water next to Naples Pier. Time is based on data from the National Lightning Detection Network. Two weeks later, local media reported that one of the men passed away after being in critical condition since the lightning strike.

events.title: Lightning near Spg-albert Whitted Airport
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. County dispatch relayed report of 4 individuals that were struck by lightning and injured while standing under a tree near downtown St. Petersburg around 5:45 pm local time. Ensuing reports detailed that all 4 individuals were teenagers, 2 females and 1 male aged 16 along with a 17 year old male, and that one of the 16 year old girls had gone into cardiac arrest. Paramedics arriving on scene were able to restore the girl's pulse before taking her to Orlando Health Bayfront Hospital in St. Petersburg, along with one of the males that had received burns, and all 4 of the individuals were…

events.title: Lightning near Douglas City
events.description: 1 death. Gadsden County. At 3:30 pm EDT on July 21, 2024, an employee working as a roofer for a roofing contractor was installing a single ply roof over an existing metal roof when a storm approached. As the crew was covering up their tools, the employee was struck by lightning. The employee died from multiple injuries due to the lightning strike.

events.title: Lightning near Miramar
events.description: 1 death. Broward County. Broadcast media reported that a 19-year-old male was killed by lightning strike as he was jogging at Vista View Park in Davie during a thunderstorm.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Killarney
events.description: 1 death. Orange County. A tree fell onto a car traveling southbound on Reams Road near Summerlake Park Boulevard in Winter Garden. A 14 year old female who was in the back seat at the time was extricated from the back seat and transported to the hospital, where she was pronounced dead. Two other passengers in the car were uninjured.

events.title: Tornado near Fort Braden
events.description: 2 deaths. Leon County. The tornado touched down in Lake Talquin State Park at Williams Landing, promptly producing EF-1 damage snapping numerous softwood and hardwood trees. The tornado would then continue trekking east-southeast before making a hard right and traveling due east as it passed the intersection of Blountstown Highway and Ft. Braden Trail Road, producing damage consistent with an EF-1 rating by snapping numerous hardwood and softwood trees along the way. The tornado would then continue east, paralleling Blountstown Highway as it then impacted Lake Talquin State Recreational Area where it would continue…

events.title: Lightning near J R Alford Greenway
events.description: 1 death. Leon County. A 73 year old man was struck by lightning and killed while walking with his wife at the J.R. Alford Greenway in Tallahassee.

events.title: Lightning near Bostwick
events.description: 1 death. Putnam County. A 16-year-old female died of her injuries after being struck by lightning while hunting with her father near Bostwick. Both were sheltering under a tree when storms approached. Lightning struck the tree, knocking both unconscious. The teen was hospitalized, but she passed away 2 days later.

events.title: Lightning near Belleair
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. The body of a 73-year-old woman was discovered on a sidewalk at the Bayside Gardens IV condominiums along Gulf Boulevard on Sand Key in Clearwater after being struck by lightning.

events.title: Lightning near Deltona
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. A 24 year-old man was working on the roof of a home on Sterling Pointe Drive in Deltona when coworkers reported he was struck by lightning, causing him to fall off of the roof. He was transported to a hospital, where he was pronounced deceased. Time estimated via lightning data.

events.title: Lightning near (cof)patrick Afb
events.description: 1 death. Brevard County. Broadcast media reported a 39 year old man was struck and killed by lightning while boating on the Indian River near US-1 and the Pineda Causeway. Another person on board was injured and taken to the hospital. Time estimated.

events.title: Flood near Alligator Lake City
events.description: 1 death. Osceola County. Rainfall totals averaging between 8 to 12 inches, with locally higher amounts of up to 16 inches were reported, resulting in widespread street, urban, and poor drainage flooding. Numerous roadways were impacted by significant levels of standing water and many retention ponds reached capacity or overflowed. Notable flooding occurred in communities adjacent to Lake Center and Runnymede Lake in St. Cloud, as well as Mill Slough and Boggy Creek in Kissimmee. A NWS Flood Survey, combined with areal photography, confirmed historic flooding along Shingle Creek and within Good Samaritan Village in…

events.title: Flood near West Holly Hill
events.description: 4 deaths. Volusia County. Rainfall totals averaging between 10 to 16 inches, with locally higher amounts of up to 20 inches were reported particularly in the coastal part of the county, resulting in widespread residential, street, urban, and poor drainage flooding. ||County drone and helicopter footage combined with on-site surveys captured considerable river and lakeshore flooding, with water entering numerous structures along the St. Johns River near Astor and South Moon Fish Camp, Lake Monroe in Stone Island, and Little Lake near Osteen. The St. Johns River reached record crests at both Astor (4.71 ft. on Oct. 1)…

events.title: Flood near Palm City
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Martin County. Heavy rain embedded within the outer bands ahead of Hurricane Ian produced widespread rainfall totals of 4 to 8 inches across Martin County, resulting in sporadic reports of street, urban, and poor drainage flooding. Several roadways were impacted by significant levels of standing water and many retention ponds reached capacity or overflowed. A 34-year-old man was discovered drowned in about 10 inches of water along the side of a road in Stuart where he was last known to be collecting work debris in preparation for the hurricane (indirect).||Emergency management officials indicated minimal…

events.title: Lightning near Scottsmoor
events.description: 2 deaths. Brevard County. The Orlando Fire Department and local news media reported that a crew boat with five boys was struck or nearly struck by lightning, causing the boat to capsize, at around 1615LST. Four of the boys made it to shore, where one was sent to the hospital. The fifth boy was missing for a time and was later found deceased. The hospitalized boy was in critical condition and was declared brain dead. He was taken off of life support a few days later.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near (orl)orlando Exec Ar
events.description: 1 death. Orange County. The ASOS at Orlando Executive Airport, KORL, measured a peak wind gust of 62 mph from a severe thunderstorm. These winds flipped over two small planes at the airport. One plane was unoccupied when it was flipped near a hanger on the airport. A second plane that had two people onboard was flipped as it was taxiing on the main runway. When first responders arrived they found one man had died from his injuries at the scene, and the other man was transported to Orlando Medical Regional Center with serious injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Winter Spgs
events.description: 1 death. Seminole County. Seminole County Emergency Management and local broadcast media relayed information about a lightning strike that killed a 42-year-old woman, and injured a 10-year-old girl and 18-year-old woman. The incident occurred near the 1300th block of Park Villa Place in Winter Springs at approximately 1320LST. Bystanders reported that lightning struck a tree just as the three victims were walking nearby. First responders and bystanders performed life saving measures, and all three victims were transported to local hospitals. The 42-year-old woman later died from her injuries, while the 10-year-old and…

events.title: Lightning near Mission City
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. Local broadcast media relayed reports that a 27-year-old man was seriously injured after being struck by lightning on Middlebury Loop in New Smyrna Beach. The victim was doing lawn maintenance when lightning struck a nearby tree, and the lightning jumped to the victim. First responders performed CPR and revived the unresponsive victim at the scene. The man was transported to Halifax Medical Center where he later died from his injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Umatilla
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Lake County. Lake County Emergency Management passed along a report of a man that was slightly injured after lightning struck a nearby fishing pole. The incident occurred along the 16500 block of Wilson Parrish Road in Umatilla at approximately 1910LST. The disoriented man was transported to a local hospital in Ocala, and was released later that day.

events.title: Tornado near Gilberts Mill
events.description: 2 deaths. Washington County. An EF-3 tornado tracked through Washington County into Jackson County Florida during the early morning hours of Thursday, March 31, 2022. The tornado began near Roland Rd and Ovid Ln in Washington County where it snapped tree trunks as it moved northeastward. The tornado crossed Orange Hill Rd and continued on to Gilberts Mill Rd. On Gilberts Mill Rd near Stewart Rd, a barn was destroyed and a manufactured home was damaged and shifted on its foundation, which is in line with EF-1 damage. Snapped and uprooted trees were observed all along Gilberts Mill Rd. Further northeast, a manufactured…

events.title: Lightning near Lakewood Ranch
events.description: 1 death. Manatee County. Broadcast Media reported a fatal lightning strike that hit a man working on a roof.

events.title: Lightning near Saint Petersburg
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. The Pinellas County Medical Examiner documented a lightning victim that passed away in hospice 26 days after the strike. The gentleman was golfing at the time of the strike. Time and location estimated as no additional information was found.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Panama City
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Bay County. One indirect fatality occurred due to hydroplaning from heavy rainfall in association with Tropical Storm Fred.

events.title: Lightning near Sanibel
events.description: 1 death. Lee County. A family of four was on the beach at Sanibel Island as a thunderstorm moved overhead. Unfortunately a lightning strike hit the father and he died of his injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Marco
events.description: 1 death. Collier County. Broadcast media relayed a report of a 17-year-old teenage boy from Georgia struck by lightning at Residents Beach on Marco Island due to a thunderstorm in the vicinity. Injuries were severe and the teen was airlifted to a hospital in Miami. Eleven (11) days later on July 28th, he unfortunately passed away due to his injuries.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Venetia
events.description: 1 death. Duval County. A tree was blown down onto 2 cars on Roosevelt Blvd. One 25 yr old male driving one of the cars was killed instantly when the large tree fell onto his vehicle. Images broadcast by media suggested the tree base may have been rotted and impacted by termites. This did not appear to be a healthy tree.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Berkeley
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Hernando County. Broadcast media confirmed a weather related fatality on Evenglow Avenue near Hyacinth Lane in Spring Hill when a vehicle crashed into a power pole downed by a fallen tree, causing the car to catch on fire, and the occupant was electrocuted when they stepped on a live power line as they attempted to exit the vehicle.

events.title: Lightning near Forest City
events.description: 1 death. Seminole County. A 58 year old man was struck and killed by a lightning strike while grilling outdoors next to a tree.

events.title: Lightning near Mill Creek
events.description: 1 death. Clay County. Three people working for Red Stag Contracting were struck by a lightning strike along Iris Street in Middleburg while working on a roof. All victims were transported to Orange Park Medical Center. One victim, a 35 year old male, was struck directly and went into cardiac arrest. He was revived via CPR on scene and was later transferred to the UF Health Shands Hospital in Gainesville, FL. He remained in a coma until his passing on 6/9/2020, at 15:45 EDT.

events.title: Lightning near Port St Lucie
events.description: 1 death. St. Lucie County. St. Lucie County Emergency Management reported that a 41-year-old man was killed after being struck by lightning at an outdoor construction site in Tradition, near Port Saint Lucie. The man was struck by lightning at approximately 1450LST and was quickly discovered by his coworkers to be unconscious. A coworker called 911 and emergency services transported the injured man to a local hospital where he later died from his injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Wellington
events.description: 1 death. Palm Beach County. Palm Beach Post reported 6 people, a woman and 5 men, were struck by lightning at the Shakerwood development off of Wellington Trace. This is west of the Mall at Wellington Green. The victims were working on the roof of a townhouse when the lightning struck. Two people, a 20-year-old woman and a man, were knocked off the roof by the lightning strike and were taken to a local hospital trauma center where the women was in critical condition. The woman died from her injuries on August 9th. ||Two others were taken to local hospitals and recovered, while the remaining two victims were treated at…

events.title: Lightning near Clearwater Beach
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. Numerous local TV stations reported 8 injuries due to a lightning strike along Clearwater Beach. One man in his 30s suffered a direct strike and went into cardiac arrest. He was sent to the hospital in critical condition where he ultimately died three days later. Three others were taken to the same hospital. A fifth was taken to Tampa General Hospital to be treated for burns. The remaining three opted not to go to the hospital.

events.title: Lightning near Kendrick
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Marion County. One person was indirectly struck and injured by lightning while on a ladder. Lighting struck a tree nearby. The patient was transported to the hospital and was expected to be ok.

events.title: Lightning near Ormond Beach Muni Ar
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. Volusia County Emergency Management and many local broadcast and newspaper media reported that a 45-year-old man from North Carolina was killed after being struck by lightning while riding his motorcycle on Interstate 95. The man was struck near mile marker 271 between State Road 40 and U.S. Highway 1. According to Florida Highway Patrol, when the man was struck by lightning he lost control of the motorcycle and careened off towards the side of the road where he crashed. Troopers announced the man died at the scene.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Woodville
events.description: 1 death. Leon County. A tree was blown down onto a home near Woodville Highway. An 8 year old girl was killed and a 12 year old boy was injured.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Sanford
events.description: 1 death. Seminole County. The large circulation around Hurricane Michael located near the western tip of Cuba combined with high pressure to the north caused quick-moving showers with gusty winds to move west across central Florida from the Atlantic. As these showers moved over inland lakes, wind gusts of 30 to 40 mph occurred. A boat containing two men who were fishing on Lake Monroe capsized due to choppy seas created by the gusty winds. One man, who was wearing a non-secured life vest, drifted away from the boat and was found deceased the following day. The other man retrieved his lift vest while hanging onto the…

events.title: Lightning near Williston Muni Arpt
events.description: 1 death. Levy County. A 49 year old woman was stripping bark off a tree in her yard when the tree was struck by lightning, injuring her. She was transported to a hospital where she died the next day.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Ormond Beach
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. Reports from Ormond Beach police and multiple local broadcast media indicated two people were injured when a large tree fell onto them in Ormond Beach. Both men were unloading furniture from a truck in the driveway of a home near Arroyo Parkway when the tree fell, and were transported to a local hospital with injuries. One man suffered a critical head injury during the incident and died the following day (July 23).

events.title: Lightning near Lake Worth
events.description: 1 death. Palm Beach County. Multiple media outlets reported that 2 men were working in a wooded area when a tree near them was struck by lightning sending the current into them. They both were then transported to local area hospitals where one man was deceased and the other survived his injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Umatilla
events.description: 1 death. Lake County. Per a report received via a local newspaper, a 44-year-old man was killed after being struck by lightning in Umatilla. At 1721 LST, a man was found unconscious by his neighbors on a small pontoon boat at his home on Lake Owen, on the 40000th block of Long Island Drive in Umatilla. The neighbors called the Lake County Sheriffs Office, and first responders transported the man to a local hospital where he was pronounced deceased. The medical examiners office determined the cause of death to be electrocution, and this is further supported by burn marks found on the seat and floor of the boat. NWS…

events.title: Lightning near Pine Shrs
events.description: 1 death. Sarasota County. A man and woman at the beach began to head for shelter as it started to rain. The man was struck by lightning, knocking back the woman back. The man was transported to a hospital, but was unable to be revived.

events.title: Lightning near Coral Spgs
events.description: 1 death. Broward County. A 55 year-old man was struck by lightning while carrying a weed wacker in the area of 7400 NW 4th place in Margate. He was taken to a nearby hospital in critical condition, and died from his injuries on Friday, June 15th.

events.title: Lightning near Boca Raton
events.description: 1 death. Broward County. A 53-year-old woman was killed when struck by a lightning strike while working at C.W. Hendrix Farms in Parkland. Two other people in the immediate area were also struck and taken to nearby hospitals.

events.title: Lightning near White Spgs
events.description: 1 death. Hamilton County. A lightning strike killed one woman and injured 4 others at the Woodpecker Mud Bog event near White Springs.

events.title: Flood near Longbeach
events.description: 1 death. Manatee County. Heavy rain started to fall over Manatee County on the 26th and continued through the 28th, with as much as 17 inches of rain falling in some areas. The highest rain totals were reported over Bradenton, mainly on the 26th through early morning on the 27th, resulting in numerous streets flooding. Cars were reported to be floating on State Road 70 near Interstate 75, requiring at least one water rescue. ||The heavy rain also caused water to enter numerous homes and businesses in Bradenton. Manatee Public Safety reporting that 67 homes, mostly in the Centre Lake community had a foot of water in…

events.title: Flood near Longboat Key
events.description: 1 death. Sarasota County. Heavy rain started to fall over Sarasota County on the 26th and continued through the 28th, with as much as 16 inches of rainfall. The highest rain totals were reported along the coast, with 14.74 inches falling in 3 days at the Sarasota/Bradenton Airport in Manatee County. This led to numerous reports of streets flooding across the area, mainly on the 26th through early morning on the 27th.||One fatality was reported in Sarasota County on the afternoon of the 27th, when a 73 year old man driving through a flooded parking lot at the dog track in Sarasota ended up in a drainage ditch and…

events.title: Lightning near (cof)patrick Afb
events.description: 1 death. Brevard County. Broadcast media reported that a group of three men were visiting the SPRA park in Satellite Beach when lighting struck two of the men. An off-duty life guard and another bystander gave CPR to one of the victims who was unconscious until Fire Rescue arrived, then both men were transported to a local hospital. One victim, a 35-year-old man from Philadelphia, Pennsylvania later died due to his injuries. The second man was only stunned by the lighting strike and had non-life threatening injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Baker
events.description: 1 death. Okaloosa County. A lightning strike killed a camper at the Wilderness Landing campground along the Blackwater River.

events.title: Lightning near Fort Myers
events.description: 1 death. Lee County. Local broadcast media reported that a 9 month pregnant woman was struck by lightning in a neighborhood in Fort Myers. She was transported to a local hospital. After arriving at the hospital, doctors delivered the baby. After a few weeks in intensive care, the child passed away. The mother was eventually released from the hospital and is back home recovering from her injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Hollywood N Perry Ar
events.description: 1 death. Broward County. Multiple members of media reported two men were struck by lightning at a construction site at the Pines City Center in Pembroke Pines. A 34-year-old man was struck directly while the other indirectly. Both men were taken to a local area hospital. The man who was struck directly had entry and exit wounds and was given CPR by other construction workers before rescue crews arrived. He was transported to a local hospital where he died. The other man who was struck indirectly complained of numbness and was transported to the hospital where he was later released.||Time of the report is when the…

events.title: Lightning near Jensen Beach
events.description: 1 death. Martin County. A weak developing thunderstorm over the nearshore waters off Martin County moved westward over Jensen Beach during the late afternoon. A 47-year-old construction worker was seriously injured when he was struck by lightning while working on a pool and club house at Ocean Breeze Park. Other co-workers on the site performed CPR until first responders arrived. The injured man was then transported to a local hospital in critical condition, and later to a regional medical center in West Palm Beach. The man died from the lightning injuries over a month later.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Ocheessee
events.description: 1 death. Calhoun County. Strong winds uprooted a large tree which fell onto a person, resulting in a fatality.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Suwannee Vly
events.description: 1 death. Columbia County. A large tree was blown down onto a mobile home and split the home in half near Interstate 10 and U.S. Highway 41. There was 1 fatality. There were additional reports of trees and power lines down across Lake City. The time of damage was based on radar.

events.title: Flood near Pond Creek
events.description: 1 death. Walton County. Flood waters were approaching a resident's home. He possibly made an attempt to walk to his vehicle and was swept away in the flood water. No other homes were affected. The person involved was an elderly male in a travel trailer and possibly fell when stepping outside. The water level outside was approximately 3 feet deep. This flooding was river flooding from the Shoal River.

events.title: Lightning near Quintette
events.description: 1 death. Escambia County. A 43 year old male was struck and killed by lightning as he was walking from his house to a detached carport.

events.title: Lightning near Newton Hgts
events.description: 1 death. Sarasota County. A 50 year old homeless woman was struck and killed by lightning. She was seeking shelter under a gazebo in the park.

events.title: Lightning near Gasparilla
events.description: 1 death. Charlotte County. William Coty Steffanni was struck by lightning while jet skiing near 1500 Gulf Boulevard in Englewood. A Sheriff Deputy dove into the water and brought Coty to shore where another deputy performed CPR. Coty was transferred to the hospital where he passed from his injuries three days later.

events.title: Lightning near Ft Walton Beach
events.description: 1 death. Okaloosa County. Lightning struck an umbrella attendant at the Island Princess Condominiums causing his death.

events.title: Lightning near Coconut
events.description: 1 death. Lee County. A 35 year old man was struck by lightning while working on the 6th floor lanai of a building under construction. Witnesses said that this was the only lightning strike seen or heard in the area from the storm. Attempts to resuscitate the man were unsuccessful, and he died at the scene.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Sweetwater Creek
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Hillsborough County. Thunderstorm wind gusts knocked down power lines along the Courtney Campbell Causeway near the Rocky Point area on the evening of the 12th. The downed power lines apparently went unnoticed until the morning of the 13th, when a 47 year old man riding a bicycle was electrocuted and killed by the live wires.

events.title: Lightning near Blake
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. A woman and man from Georgia were near the waters edge at the 3100 block of South Atlantic Avenue in Daytona Beach Shores when they were struck by lightning from a thunderstorm located about 4 miles to the north. The woman was unconscious when she was transported to the hospital and later died. The man was conscious and also transported to the hospital with injuries. Another woman nearby was also affected by the strike, but was able to walk away and seek treatment on her own.

events.title: Lightning near Myakka Head
events.description: 1 death. Manatee County. Three farm workers were struck by lightning while loading a truck. One was killed and the other two sustained injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Golden Gate
events.description: 1 death. Collier County. OSHA reported a fatality due to a lightning strike to a construction worker who was struck while working on a roof. The date of death was reported to be the following day, May 29th, 2016.

events.title: Lightning near Hypoluxo
events.description: 1 death. Palm Beach County. A 23 year old male was struck by lightning while standing underneath a tree in front of his home at 250 North Palm Drive in Boynton Beach. CPR was performed at the scene and he was transported to Bethesda Medical Center, where he later died from his injuries.

events.title: Lightning near Jupiter Is
events.description: 1 death. Martin County. A 41-year old man was struck by lightning in Jonathan Dickinson State Park, south of Hobe Sound. The man was playing catch with his son in a grassy field when he was struck by lightning on the top of his head. He was transported to a hospital in critical condition and died on April 4.

events.title: Tornado near Oak Knoll
events.description: 2 deaths. Manatee County. The NWS Storm Survey found a single-wide mobile home destroyed and rolled over. Seven people were inside the home, two adults were killed with four injured. The tornado also destroyed a 2000 square foot barn. The damage was in a very rural, isolated area and the Manatee County Sheriffs surveyed the storm track by helicopter and found numerous trees down along the path.

events.title: Lightning near Wesconnett
events.description: 1 death. Duval County. Lightning struck a tree, which then struck a moving vehicle along Jammes Road at the intersection of Turknett Road. The driver was killed due to the falling tree. The car then drove into the ditch.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Belmont
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Pinellas County. Pinellas County Emergency Manager reported a fatality indirectly related to thunderstorms in the area. The decedent was clearing branches and debris from the single story roof at his residence and fell to the ground sustaining head trauma. He was transported to Morton Plant Hospital where he was pronounced dead a short time later.

events.title: Lightning near Golden Beach
events.description: 1 death. Miami-dade County. One person killed and 2 injured by lightning strike near a group of men sheltering under tree in park in Northeast Miami-Dade County. Exact location and time estimated.

events.title: Heavy Rain near Pinellas Park
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. Pinellas County Emergency Management relayed a report from the Medical Examiner of a 58 year old homeless man who was found face down submerged in a drainage area that was filled with storm water on July 29th. The man was resuscitated and taken to a hospital where he eventually expired on August 4th. The Medical Examiner ruled that the cause of death was complications of drowning, with contributing conditions of arteriosclerotic cardiovascular disease and chronic ethanolism.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Wakulla
events.description: 1 death. Wakulla County. A large tree fell on a mobile home on Timberwood Ct and killed the 25 year old female occupant as reported by WTXL-TV.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Gainesville East
events.description: 1 death. Alachua County. A tree limb was blown down at Poe Springs park, which hit a woman on the head. Two others were injured. The woman died due to head trauma from the tree limb.

events.title: Lightning near Harbor Pt
events.description: 1 death. Volusia County. A 25-year-old male was struck and killed by lightning while working on the roof of a home in the Water's Edge subdivision of Port Orange.

events.title: Lightning near Belmont
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. Florida Emergency Management reported that an 81 year old man was struck and killed while walking near his home in Largo.

events.title: Lightning near Bonita Spgs
events.description: 1 death. Lee County. Two men working on a roof were struck by lightning. They stopped working when it began to rain but returned shortly after the rain had stopped. Neighbors said that the lightning strike hit a roofer directly in the head ï¿½ï¿½ï¿½ knocking him unconscious. That bolt then transferred to another worker who was just steps away. They were transferred to a local hospital to be treated for their injuries. The man who was struck directly died from his injuries three days later.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Biscayne Park
events.description: 1 death. Miami-dade County. A building maintenance worker was killed after he was struck by a glass tabletop that flew off a 9th floor balcony of Flamingo Apartments in Miami Beach. The tabletop flew off during high winds from thunderstorms which affected the area. Nearest measured wind gust was 46 mph at the City of Miami Beach Police Headquarters at 656 PM EDT. It is likely winds were higher at the 9th floor of the building. Report was supplemented with information from City of Miami Beach Department of Emergency Management.

events.title: Lightning near Ft Myers Beach
events.description: 1 death. Lee County. Local law enforcement and media reported a lightning strike on Fort Myers Beach. Three people were walking on the beach with thunderstorms in the area. A 41 year old male was struck and killed. Two others were injured, one critically, and were transported to a local hospital.

events.title: Lightning near South Sarasota
events.description: 1 death. Sarasota County. A 39 year old man was struck and killed by lightning while roofing a home near Siesta Key. The man was taken to a nearby hospital but was unable to be revived.

events.title: Thunderstorm Wind near Lake Lindsey
events.description: 1 death (indirect). Hernando County. A large tree branch fell on a moving vehicle causing the driver to lose control and crash resulting in his death. Heavy rain and quarter sized hail was reported also with this storm at the time of the crash.

events.title: Lightning near Allentown
events.description: 1 death. Santa Rosa County. A lightning strike killed a 71 year old man while he was out in a field picking blueberries.

events.title: Lightning near Pompano Beach
events.description: 1 death. Broward County. Broadcast media relayed a report of two male construction workers struck by lightning from a thunderstorm just northwest of their location while working on a roof of a auto dealership at 909 South Federal Highway in Pompano Beach. Both men were transported to a local hospital. One of them, a 55-year-old, was in critical condition. He died from his injuries a few days later on Monday, June 2nd.

events.title: Lightning near Oakhurst
events.description: 1 death. Pinellas County. A male construction worker at 7245 102nd Lane North in Seminole was struck and killed by a lightning strike.

events.title: Lightning near Pleasant Grove
events.description: 1 death. Hillsborough County. A 71 year old man was fishing in a lake at Edward Medard Park when he was apparently struck and killed by lightning. The man was found face down in the water just after 7 PM with signs of electrocution.

events.title: Flash Flood near Gulf Beach
events.description: 1 death. Escambia County. Central and southern Escambia county experienced historic flooding the night of April 29th into the early morning of April 30th. Nearly 2 feet of rain fell across portions of southern Escambia County. Pensacola International Airport recorded a storm total of 20.47 inches. 1687 residential homes suffered major flooding with 12 inches of water or more. 1518 residential homes suffered minor flooding with less than 12 inches of water. 13 homes were destroyed. 117 commercial businesses experienced major damage. ||Widespread infrastructure damage, totaling $90 million, occurred with numerous roads,…

events.title: Flash Flood near Delray Beach
events.description: 2 deaths. Palm Beach County. Intense thunderstorms began to develop over the east coast metropolitan area of Palm Beach County during the evening hours and began to train across the same areas for the next several hours. As a result, high rainfall amounts were observed from Delray Beach to Jupiter. The heaviest rain fell from about 8 PM to Midnight.
